author: Yffe
content: Add --out <PATH> / -o <PATH> to forge build. After build_file's invoke_rustc produces the stable /tmp artifact, a new place_artifact in build.rs copies it to the user-named <PATH> (std::fs::copy overwrites; chmod +x on unix so ./<PATH> runs directly) and reports <PATH> as BuildManifest::artifact; None keeps the existing /tmp path. build_file gains an out: Option<&Path> param; cli.rs parses --out/-o (separate value token, missing-value Usage error, short flag reachable via starts_with('-')) into Command::Build.out and threads it through run_build. Bad path -> structured ForgeError::Io, never a panic. Verification/lowering untouched (byte-identical artifact). Design doc gets REQ-7 + AC-8. Tests: build_conformance out_places_runnable_binary + out_bad_path_is_structured_error, cli parses_build_out_flag.
